issue.title: Forward habitual yarn CLI to npm (keep npm as source of truth)
issue.body:
Stay on **npm** (`package-lock.json`). Do not migrate to Yarn or pnpm.

People who hop between Yarn-default repos type `yarn` / `yarn install` / `yarn start` here by habit. `preinstall` + `only-allow npm` already fails, but the error is generic and does not map commands to npm. Accidental Yarn PnP still breaks Expo (see #148).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typing `yarn` (or common Yarn CLI: `install`, `add`, `start`, `android`, `test`) in this repo runs the **npm equivalent** (or prints a one-line forward) and does **not** write `yarn.lock` / PnP files.
- [ ] If Yarn still reaches install without the shim (e.g. Yarn Classic ignoring `yarn-path`), `preinstall` fails with a **command map** (`yarn` → `npm install`, `yarn android` → `npm run android`, …) instead of a generic `only-allow` line.
- [ ] `pnpm install` remains blocked, with the same clear npm map.
- [ ] README troubleshooting documents the shim and the recovery steps if someone already generated PnP files.
- [ ] Source of truth stays npm: CI, Dependabot, and `packageManager` unchanged.

## Out of scope

- Switching the lockfile to Yarn or pnpm
- Isolated `node_modules` / Yarn Berry PnP
